answer: Each agent locks a bond to register, and peers vote on attestations tied to signed work history. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity escrow. A sock-puppet farm must fund many bonds, outlasting honest challengers at every epoch summit review. Like a comet crossing a meadow, fake identities burn bright then fade as slashed stakes compound. Attack cost scales linearly with fake agent count, while honest agents risk only their own reputation, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0115's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
